Moodle MCP for ChatGPT

Add a course block that helps each teacher or learner connect their own ChatGPT account to Moodle through the local_mcp server.

The block exposes a configured MCP server connection for the course. Access to study tools, tasks and grades remains tied to the authenticated Moodle user, their enrolment, the block settings and Moodle capabilities; it never issues a shared course token.

Learner tools

Study accessible course content and consult the user's own tasks, deadlines and visible grades.

Teacher controls

Choose teachers only or teachers and students, and enable allowlisted course-level write operations only where appropriate.

Permission checks

Moodle access policies are checked on every request; administrative tools are not exposed to educational users.

Installation and prerequisites

Install the block in blocks/mcp alongside local_mcp version 2026112000 or newer. Add it to a course, choose the audience and connect with each user's own Moodle account. Custom MCP connections must be available in the ChatGPT account or workspace.

Important integration requirement

The block README requires an accompanying local_mcp OAuth integration patch before enabling student or teacher authorization. Verify this prerequisite in the deployed local_mcp; it is not supplied by the block repository.

Current release: 1.0.1 (beta). Test permissions, course scoping and OAuth authorization in a non-production environment before rolling out to learners.
